name: sanguo-kg-rocksdb-edge
description: The same 《三国演义》knowledge graph served by the RocksDB-Edge storage: the vertex id is the plain entity name (no relation shard), and the edges live in an edge table per edge class, so a whole person is one range scan instead of ten sharded records. Directed Entity_Entity relations (max out-/in-degree 2000) carrying relation/xrelation/relationLabel/relationFamily

vertexSchemas.name: Entity
vertexSchemas.description: A knowledge-graph entity (person / faction / place / office / chapter), keyed by its name

properties.name: name
properties.description: Entity name (人物/势力/籍贯/官职/章回)

properties.name: historicity
properties.description: 史实人物 / 虚构人物

properties.name: birthYear
properties.description: 出生年（公元，公元前为负）

properties.name: eventYearEnd
properties.description: 事件结束年（区间事件才有，如六出祁山 234）

properties.name: role
properties.description: 人物角色（君主/军师/谋士/武将/文臣/隐士）

edgeSchemas.name: Entity_Entity
edgeSchemas.description: A directed relation between two entities

properties.name: xrelation
properties.description: Reverse relation name; equals relation when it has no inverse

properties.name: year
properties.description: 年份区间：两端点共现的公元年，如 196-208

properties.name: chapter
properties.description: 回数区间：两端点共现的章回号，如 35-48

properties.name: seq
properties.description: 叙述序：字段序*1000+句子序，越小越早；同字段内可比
